info.name: TGSCO Backend API
info.description:
TGSCO e-commerce and portfolio content management API.

Variable conventions:
- {{base_url}} is the API host and port.
- {{admin_token}} and {{admin_refresh_token}} are filled by the Admin Login and Admin Refresh requests.
- Add variables only when the corresponding backend workflow is implemented.

When adding a workflow, create the appropriate numbered folder and subfolders, add its reusable IDs or tokens as collection variables, then save response values in that workflow's Tests script with pm.collectionVariables.set().

formdata.value: {"eyebrow":"A Chain of Craft","title":"Every TGSCO product passes through many hands before it reaches yours","roles":[{"eyebrow":"Growing the Foundation","title":"Farmers","description":"The journey of every handloom fabric begins in the fertile fields where dedicated farmers cultivate high-quality cotton with patience, care, and generations of agricultural expertise. Through months of nurturing the crop, they ensure that each cotton boll reaches its finest quality before harvest. Their commitment to sustainable farming practices and careful harvesting lays the foundation for creating soft, durable, and naturally beautiful textiles. Without their dedication, the story of handloom craftsmanship could never begin.","color":"#C95D52","imageField":"roles[0].image","imageAlt":"Farmers harvesting cotton"},{"eyebrow":"Preparing the Yarn","title":"Yarn Suppliers","description":"Once the cotton is harvested, it reaches skilled yarn suppliers who transform raw fibres into strong, uniform yarn through a meticulous process of cleaning, carding, combing, and spinning. Every stage is carefully monitored to preserve the fibre's natural strength while achieving the ideal texture required for weaving. Their expertise ensures that every spool of yarn meets the highest quality standards, creating a reliable foundation for vibrant colours, intricate designs, and durable handwoven fabrics.","color":"#E3A900","imageField":"roles[1].image","imageAlt":"Natural coloured yarn"},{"eyebrow":"Bringing Colour to Life","title":"Dyers","description":"Colour is what gives every handloom fabric its personality and charm. Each batch is dyed with precision to ensure consistency, colourfastness, and lasting brilliance while preserving the softness of the fibres. item.name: 08 Video Media
item.description: Admin-only DigitalOcean Spaces video upload and delete endpoints. Maximum upload size is 100 MB. Upload returns a public URL and storage key; use the key when deleting.

item.name: Delete Video
item.description: Delete a previously uploaded video using the key returned by Upload Video.
